Motor insurance options in India can be complex, which is why Policybazaar built its market-leading reputation by making the consumer journey entirely transparent and accessible. The digital platform empowers millions of unique buyers to seamlessly research, compare policies from dozens of competing providers side-by-side. While this transparent architecture successfully optimized front-end customer onboarding, an unavoidable regulatory hurdle historically disrupted this experience whenever a customer attempted to renew an expired vehicle policy. These ‘break-in cases' mandate a comprehensive vehicle inspection to verify integrity before any new coverage can be issued.
